name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-govt-nz

tools.name: package_list
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — paginated list of all dataset slugs/names. Use to enumerate available datasets before fetching details with package_show.

tools.name: package_show
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — full metadata for a dataset by ID/slug: title, description, resources (download URLs + formats), organization, tags, and license.

tools.name: organization_list
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — list NZ government organizations that publish datasets. Pass all_fields=true to return names and descriptions instead of just IDs.

tools.name: organization_show
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — full profile for a publishing organization by ID: name, description, and optionally their list of published datasets.

tools.name: group_list
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — list thematic groups/categories used to organise NZ open datasets. Pass all_fields=true for names and descriptions.

tools.name: group_show
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — full detail for a thematic group by ID: title, description, and optionally the datasets it contains.

tools.name: tag_list
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — list all dataset tags, optionally filtered by query string. Use to browse taxonomy before filtering package_search by tag.

tools.name: tag_show
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — detail for a single tag by name/ID, optionally including the list of datasets tagged with it.

tools.name: recently_changed_packages
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — datasets most recently created or updated, paginated by limit/offset. Use to monitor NZ government open data activity.

tools.name: resource_show
tools.description: New Zealand open data catalogue (data.govt.nz CKAN) — metadata for a single resource (file/download) by resource ID: URL, format, size, description, and last modified date.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-govt-nz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-govt-nz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
